One bounded local managed-proxy request without redirect following returned HTTP200. Only response headers and a small HTML prefix were retained in hosted-fetch-triage/mn-redirect-diagnostic.json; this separate observation does not reproduce or resolve the direct-hosted rejection.
records.recommendedAction: Preserve the public-HTTPS/SSRF guard.
